D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P [F AVG?] ; R/ PAX [AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293), Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS P [F AVG?]. Reverse description: Pax standing left holding branch and vertical and sceptre. Reverse inscription: PAX [AVG]. Unattributed Mint. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 1.73gms, die axis: 6.
